newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: URA property index falls 1.0 pct in 2Q.
newsitem.headline: URA property index falls 1.0 pct in 2Q.

text.p: The overall property price index fell by 1.0 percent in the second quarter againsts a 3.4 percent fall in the first quarter, said Singapore's Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) on Friday.
Prices of residential properties fell by 0.8 percent during the quarter against a 3.7 percent drop in the first quarter.
The number of caveats lodged on residential properties, indicating level of transaction activity, was 2,304, 38.3 percent higher than the 1,666 lodged in the previous quarter.
Prices of commercial properties fell by 2.3 percent against a 4.3 percent fall previously.
Industrial properties fell 2.1 percent against an increase of 4.3 percent previously.
